_comment: FORMAT EXAMPLE. Copy to seed/ (gitignored) and replace every REPLACE-ME with the real identifier. Never commit seed/.
_loaded_by: prisme-sync bindings --from <path>. A REPLACE-ME left in place is refused by the loader rather than bound: a store addressed by the literal string "REPLACE-ME" fails at the first query, nowhere near this file.
_duration_property: If a process page carries its declared duration in a property, name it in DOCTOOL_DURATION_PROPERTY rather than here. It is what makes the duration preference order three-tier instead of two (docs/12-scoring.md §4).

documentTool._comment: Role key -> external database ID. prisme never refers to these databases by name; see docs/17-privacy.md. Access levels are enforced when sharing the integration, and are listed here so the intent is explicit.

processes_db._note: Owned outright by the document tool. prisme reads duration and frequency and writes nothing (ADR-0016).

documentTool._adr_0025: Where a narrative page is created, and what it is a copy of (ADR-0011, ADR-0019, ADR-0025, ADR-0028). A kind is addressable only when BOTH its store and its template are bound; a half-bound kind blocks with a reason rather than making a page with no parent or an empty one. Any of the kinds may share one identifier if that is how the workspace is organised; the distinction is prisme's.

capture_pages_db._note: ADR-0028. A capture is not yet an initiative, and ADR-0025 declined to guess which of the two it would become.

intentLabels._comment: Consumed then removed by the reconciler — the intent channel in docs/16-sync.md.

areaMappings._comment: Many-to-one: several projects and sections may map to one area key. This is how disagreeing area lists across two tools fold into one canonical list WITHOUT restructuring either tool.

areaMappings._home: Optional. Where prisme creates new work for the area — at most one per area. Without one, the most specific mapping is used.

_rules: Every project and section that can receive work should map to exactly one area. Unmapped work is REPORTED, never silently dropped — an unmapped project is a configuration gap.
A dedicated project for a large effort maps to the area its Project entity belongs to.
Changing a mapping re-attributes future capacity only. Historical capacity keeps the attribution in force at the time, for the same reason weights are year-scoped.
